The '''ocular enhancer''' was a device equipped with lenses and worn over the [[Eye/Legends|eyes]]. Tapping the side of the ocular enhancer could darken the lenses to protect against bright light such as that produced by a [[Fusioncutter/Legends|fusion cutter]], and simultaneously increase magnification by a factor of two hundred percent. The [[Tynnan/Legends|Tynnan]] explosives expert and [[Thief/Legends|thief]] [[Dawson (Tynnan)|Dawson]] owned an ocular enhancer, which he used to compensate for his [[Species/Legends|species]]' lackluster vision. Dawson wore the device during a [[Heist on the Song of the Clouds|heist]] aboard the [[Ithorian Herdship]] ''[[Song of the Clouds]]''<ref name="HerdHeist" /> and a subsequent visit to the<ref name="FP">''[[Fair Prey]]''</ref> [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim Territories]]<ref name=EssAtOnComp">''[[The Essential Atlas]]'' &mdash; Based on corresponding data for [[Kabal system/Legends|Kabal system]]</ref> [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Kabal/Legends|Kabal]]<ref name="FP" /> in [[0 ABY/Legends|0 ABY]].<ref name="EssReaComp">''[[The Essential Reader's Companion]]''</ref>

==Behind the scenes==
The ocular enhancer first appeared in "[[The Great Herdship Heist]]," a story written by [[Daniel Wallace]] and featured in the [[Star Wars Adventure Journal 15|fifteenth issue]] of ''[[Star Wars Adventure Journal]]'' in [[November]] [[1997]]. Illustrations of Dawson wearing an ocular enhancer were drawn by [[Will Warren]].<ref name="HerdHeist" />
